name: Minamifurano (Japan)
description: A purple field charged at the centre with the Minamifurano town emblem in white: a broken ring beneath a bar, enclosing the character 南 in stylised form.
history: Municipal flag of Minamifurano, a town in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted in March 1967.

features.role: Minamifurano town emblem — a broken ring beneath a bar, enclosing the character 南 in stylised form
